$description: Frozen instrument catalog snapshot generated from Audio Library Master File.xlsx. The brain consumes only this file; the xlsx is the source of truth at import time but is never read at runtime. `contentHash` is a SHA-256 over the canonical bytes of `entries` and is verified on load — a hand-edited snapshot whose hash has not been recomputed will throw at the loader.

LEGACY_PROVENANCE.transform: Per sheet: forward-fill column 1 (subcategory); trim every string; split `add. styles` on comma; coerce `bpm` to integer or null; pass `key`, `normalisation`, `status`, `legacyReplacement` through verbatim. Rows whose library AND preset are both blank are dropped (subcategory-declaration rows) and reported in rowsSkipped.subcategoryHeaderOnly. Empty sheets are reported but not flagged.
